chapter.verse: Pasian' hong puak Lungdamna Thu' adinga hong kituamkoih, sawltak dinga sapkhiatna a ngah, Khris Jesu' sila khat ahi keimah Paul in kong hopih hi.
Lungdamna Thu ka cih ciangin Pasian in ama' kamsangte' tungtawnin Pasian' Laibupi siangtho sungah hong kamciam kholhsa thu,
ama' Tapa tawh a kisai thu hi a, cilesa lamsang ah David' suan,
sianthona Kha lamsang ah misite' lakpan a thawhkikna tawh vanglian thunei Pasian' Tapa ci-in a kiciamteh, i Topa Jesu Khris ii thu, ahi hi.
Ama' min tawh minam khempeuh lakah upna thu a kizuih theih nadingin kote in ama' hangin hehpihna leh sawltak nasep a ngah ka hi uh hi.
Tua banga a ngahte lakah Jesu Khris' pawl ahi dingin sapkhiatna a ngah note zong na kihel uh hi.
Pasian' hong it, ama' mi siangtho dinga hong sapkhiat, Rome khuapi-a om note khempeuh' tungah hehpihna hong tung henla i Pa Pasian leh Topa Jesu Khris' kiangpan nopna lemna hong om ta hen.
A masapenin leitung bup ah note' upna thu kipulak ahih manin no teng khempeuh' hangin ka Pasian' tungah Jesu Khris' min tawh lungdam ka ko hi.
A hang pen note tatsat lo-in hong phawk ka hih thu, ama' Tapa' Lungdamna Thu vai ah ka kha tawh a na ka sep Pasian pen ka teci ahi hi.
Thungetna ah kong hel den a, Pasian' deihna tawh kituakin lam khat teitei tawh note' kiangah kong tun zawh veve nadingin thu ka ngen hi.
Note hong thakhauhsak ding ahi, hehpihna kha gah khatpeuh kong hop theih nadingin note kong mu nuam mahmah hi.
Cihnopna ah note' upna tawh ahi-a kei' upna tawh ahi zongin i upna tek tawh eite khatlekhat tha i kipiak tuak ding a gen nuam ka hi hi.

Sanggamte aw, note leh Gentile a omlai teng lakah gahleteh ka neih theih nadingin note' kiangah kong pai sawm zelzelna thu (himah taleh tu ciangciang kipelh ahihna thu) na theihkhak loh ding uh kong deihsak kei hi.
Kei pen Greek mite leh khuata mite' tungah ahi zongin, a piltatte leh a haitatte' tungah ahi zongin vekpi' tungah vaipuak a nei ka hi hi.
Tua hangin Rome khua-a om note' kiangah zong Lungdamna Thu tangko ding ka lawp mahmah hi.
A hang pen Lungdamna Thu ka zumpih kei hi. Lungdamna Thu cih pen a masa-in Jew mite, a zom ah Greek mite cih bangin a umte khempeuh hotkhiatna a ngahsak Pasian' vangliatna ahi hi.
Tua Lungdamna Thu sungah Pasian' dikna thu hong kilang a, “Midikmi a upna tawh nungta ding hi,” ci-in a kigelh mah bangin tua dikna thu pen upna tunga kinga-in upna tawh a kipan ahi hi.
Mihingte in amau' siattatna tawh thumaan thutak siincip uh ahih manin amaute' kihtakbei gamtatna leh siattatna khempeuh hangin vantung panin Pasian' hehna hong kilang hi.
A hang pen Pasian in ama' thu a kithei thei ding teng amaute' tungah lak khinzo ahih manin amau zong tua thu a thei uh ahi hi.

A hang pen leitung piansakna hun-a kipanin muhtheihloh Pasian' pianzia ahi, ama' tawntung vangliatna leh amah Pasian ahihna thu, a kipiangsak nate sungah teltak kimu-in kithei thei hi. Tua hangin amaute a kiphelh nading uh paulap om theilo hi.
A hang pen amaute in Pasian thei napi-un Pasian ahihna zah pahtawi lo-in hehpihna zong phat lo uh ahih manin a ngaihsutna uh a mawknapi suak a, lungsim mawlin thulela tel theilo hi.
Pil a kisak uh hangin a hai hita uh hi.
A sitheilo Pasian' minpha mun ah a sithei mihing, vasa, khelinei ganhing, bokvak awmtal ganhing cihte tawh a kibang milimte koih uh hi.
Tua ahih manin amau' pumpi amaumah in a daisak ahih nadingun Pasian in amau' lungsim sunga om cilesa lunggulhnate, thanghuai gamtatna sungah khahkhong hi.
A hang pen amaute in Pasian' thumaan thutak pen zuau thu tawh khek uh a, Piangsakpa bia lo-in a kipiangsak nate bia-in tuate' na sem uh hi. A Piangsak Topa mah a tawntungin thuphangah hizaw hi. Amen.
Hih thu hangin Pasian in a zumhuai pumpi kilunggulhna namte ah amaute khahkhong hi. A hang pen a numeite un pianngeizia banga omkhop pen pianngeizia ahilote tawh khek uh hi.

Pasalte zong numei tawh omkhop ngeinate nusia-in khatlekhat kilunggulhna in vuknelh ahih manin khat in khat' tungah zumhuai gamtatnate bawl a, amau' paikhialhna tawh kituakin amaumah in gawtna tuak uh hi.
Amaute in Pasian thusimtaak sa lo uh ahih manin Pasian in zong a hihhuailo thute a hih nadingun haihuai lungmawlna sungah khahkhong hi.

Amaute pen siattatna namkim, gitlohna, huaihamna, siatsaknopna cihte tawh kidim uh hi. A lungsim uhah hazatna, tualthahna, kitotna, khemna, leh siat nading bawlna cihte bek om hi. Amaute pen migensiate,
migendaite, Pasian a mudahte, awlmawh zahtak a neilote, a kiphasakte, a kisialte, thusia a phuangte, nulehpa' thu a manglote,
thu ngaihsun theilote, ciampelin a muanhuailote, khualna a neilote, cikziat a neilote ahi uh hi.
Tua banga a gamtate sihna tuahtaak cih Pasian' thumaan khenna thu thei tek napi-un amau mahmah tua bangin gamta banah tua banga a gamta mite awi-am uh hi.
